svg.title: PDF Search on Qdrant + Cohere slaps!
svg.desc: A connected PDF search flow inside an email window. Embed 5 Pro embeds a page image. Qdrant keeps a 512-dimensional binary search copy in RAM and full 2048-dimensional vectors on disk. An 8-bit query searches the RAM copy to select 20 candidates. Those candidates are re-scored with the full query and full vectors read from disk, producing the top 10 pages. Gray arrows show stored page representations; red arrows trace the search. The email controls are decorative.
svg.text: PDF Search on Qdrant + Cohere slaps!
